meta.name: anyone-proxy
meta.description: This skill enables IP address masking and accessing hidden services on the Anyone Network. Route requests through the Anyone Protocol VPN network using a local SOCKS5 proxy.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要隐藏IP或访问暗网服务。
copy.tagline_en: Mask your IP and access hidden services.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Anyone 网络路由请求，隐藏你的真实 IP 地址，并可以访问隐藏服务。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 访问某个网站或服务，且需要隐藏 IP 或访问隐藏服务时触发。

say.text: 通过代理访问某个隐藏服务
say.note: Claude 会通过 Anyone 网络路由请求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will route requests through the Anyone network, hiding your real IP address and enabling access to hidden services.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to access a website or service that requires IP masking or hidden service access.

say_en.note: Claude will fetch your anonymous IP via proxy.

say_en.text: Access a hidden service through the proxy
say_en.note: Claude will route the request through the Anyone network.
